listing.name: Wario Land: Super Mario Land 3 / Bigodão (GABRIELNNK)
listing.summary: Link an independently permitted, completed Bigodão Windows build; upstream owns exact ROM/DX preparation, updates and save storage.

steps.title: Use a completed Windows copy
steps.instruction: Use an independently permitted, already completed Windows native Bigodão build with wario_land_port.exe from the upstream CMake target. Keep its complete runtime and tools/wl_sm3_dx_v12_patch.json together in a writable folder. This route does not build missing generated game code or identify the contents of an uninspected release ZIP.

steps.title: Keep exact original and patch inputs
steps.instruction: For upstream first-run preparation, supply your legally obtained Wario Land - Super Mario Land 3 (World) ROM (SHA-256 ac1682f17abcf590311a233289ee325214c2d71ab3a5aa175004002d85075e56) and independently permitted korxo DX v1.2 IPS patch (SHA-256 599d9f59090df3e1e77c1678e069290a2cd9ce59c71cf58d66c4dc3db8b7facd). Owning the game or the project code license does not grant acquisition or redistribution of the patch or optional music/art packs.

steps.title: Back up old and new storage before startup
steps.instruction: Before first startup or an update, close Bigodão and separately back up the complete old and new folders, saves/, legacy loose .sav/.rtc/.state files, wario.o2r and any .tmp recovery file, mods/, and the SDL preference directory for gbrecompiled/runtime (normally %APPDATA%/gbrecompiled/runtime/runtime_prefs.ini; local runtime_prefs.ini is a fallback). Startup copies eligible legacy loose saves into missing saves/ destinations and retains the old files; failure to create saves/ falls back to beside-executable storage.

steps.title: Let upstream prepare its private data package
steps.instruction: Complete the upstream ROM/IPS picker before registration. It patches a copy in memory and creates wario.o2r beside the executable, with a current-directory fallback for an existing package. An older texture recipe can request re-preparation; creation verifies a temporary package, then removes the prior package before renaming the replacement. Keep the separate pre-start backup and original inputs; cancelling that update can continue with the previously loaded old ROM.

steps.title: Link the ordinary native executable
steps.instruction: Add the completed wario_land_port.exe through the existing-copy route, choose its containing folder as the working directory, and leave arguments empty. The picker and normal game loop run inside that process. Do not select Android files, packaging tools, or a compiler helper.

steps.title: Preserve saves, preferences and mods
steps.instruction: Preserve the complete saves/ folder, legacy save copies, preferences, mods/ including 3d_marcas.txt, captures and custom packs. The selected runtime uses wario_land_sm3_dx_v12 for saves; upstream owns save-slot replacement/deletion and all compatibility decisions. Save or mod compatibility across other ports, builds or editions is not established.

steps.title: Keep replacement ownership upstream
steps.instruction: Quit the game completely before maintenance, relinking or removal. Upstream and the user own preparation, runtime replacement and updates; Portcove only links the selected executable and does not install, update, roll back, move or delete this external copy or its player data.
